_comment: Vows (D-010, D-032). Veyr's standing law is that a vow spoken before a witness binds; at a vow-stone anyone may swear one. A Vow is a law of tier VOW with its author as subject: it grants nothing while it stands, it falls when the named thing happens, and it is kept when its author clears a post under it. Kept: Resonance made whole, and standing (added to the authority of every law they impose, until they next rest). Fallen: the forfeit in harm, on the spot, and all standing lost.

laws.name: The Watched Back
laws.thesis: I will not be struck from behind.
laws.text: VOW. If a blow from behind harms me, the vow falls: I pay 15, and my word is worth nothing. Kept, my word weighs 2 more.

laws.name: The Varied Hand
laws.thesis: I will not make the same strike twice running.
laws.text: VOW. If I repeat my own last strike by hand, the vow falls: I pay 20, and my word is worth nothing. Kept, my word weighs 3 more.

breach.reason: I made the same strike twice

laws.name: Bare Hands
laws.text: VOW. If I impose a law, the vow falls: I pay 20, and my word is worth nothing. A law of mine that another law refuses was never imposed. Kept, my word weighs 3 more.

laws.name: The Unmarked
laws.thesis: I will not be struck from the front.
laws.text: VOW. If a blow from the front harms me, even through my guard, the vow falls: I pay 25, and my word is worth nothing. Kept, my word weighs 4 more.

breach.reason: I was struck from the front
